name: Junkyard, Entrance
desc1: This dirty, rectangular plot is filled with all manner of heavy,
desc2: useless objects, such as smashed statues, ruined carts, mangled
desc3: furniture, and corroded armour. In the centre of the lot stands a
desc4: strange, gleaming metal contraption, emblazoned with the High Guild of
desc5: Magery's seal. A plaque on the opposite side to the seal apparently
desc6: details instructions on its use. The junkyard continues to the north
desc7: and east, with a path onto Noble street to the south.
